visual.description: Left half contains headline, subtext, and two CTA buttons; right half shows a large dashboard UI screenshot, with both columns roughly 50/50 on a dark background.
Six enterprise brand logos (Deloitte, GM, EY, Nestlé, Bosch, Decathlon) displayed in a single evenly-spaced horizontal row across the full width.

Centered headline 'Build like a team of hundreds' above a single horizontal tab bar grouping product categories (Auth, Databases, Storage, Functions, Realtime, Messaging under BUILD; Sites under DEPLOY).
Two equal-width dark cards side by side, each with an icon, title, description text, and a product UI illustration below.
Three equal-width dark cards in a row showing Storage, Functions, and Messaging with icon, title, description, and a product UI mockup each.
Two equal-width dark cards for Realtime and Sites, each with icon, title, multi-line description, and a UI illustration below.
Two equal-width dark cards presenting MCP and Skills AI features, each with a UI mockup and description text below.
Full-width tabular layout showing LLM model names, pricing, and benchmark percentage columns spanning the entire content area.
A large centered testimonial card with a case study quote overlaps a row of flanking company logos on both sides at a narrower width.
Left column holds a large headline; right column holds supporting paragraph text, on a light background.
Eight security features arranged in two rows of four equal columns, each cell containing an icon, feature name, and short description separated by thin grid lines.
Full-width section on a light background showing a dotted world map with pink markers, and a three-tab toggle (PoP Locations, Edges, Regions) centered below it.
Three large stat figures (50K+ GitHub stars, 300+ PoP locations, and one more) arranged horizontally with vertical dividers on a light background transitioning to dark.
Dark section with a large left-aligned headline and two CTA buttons (primary and secondary) aligned to the right on the same row.
Three pricing plan cards (Free, Pro, Enterprise) in equal-width columns on a dark background, each showing plan name, price, and description.
Footer with a logo+brand column on the far left followed by five equal-width link columns (Quick Starts, Products, Learn, Programs, About), all on a dark background.
Bottom bar with social media icons left-aligned, copyright text centered, a status indicator centered-right, and legal links (Terms, Privacy, Cookies) far right.
